title: Strange Printer
description: Calculate minimum turns to print string by overwriting ranges.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize dp[n][n] table with zeros
2. For len = 1 to n: dp[i][i+len-1] = len
3. For len = 2 to n: For i = 0 to n-len: Find min turns for sub-ranges
4. Handle s[i] == s[j] case to optimize moves
5. Return dp[0][n-1]

steps.note: Base case: single characters require 1 turn.
Evaluate range [0, 2] ('aaa'). Since all same, cost remains 1.
Final DP result for range [0, 5] is 2.
